meta.note: Prices are the supplier's listed prices converted from VND at the stated rate. Duplicate listings are flagged in duplicate_of.

products.description_en: Envato Elements is an all-in-one digital subscription for creatives: unlimited downloads of premium templates, fonts, stock video, music, photos, graphics and courses under a single commercial license. This upgrade activates the Core plan directly on your own email — ideal for designers, video editors, marketers and freelancers.

Make.com is a no-code, drag-and-drop automation platform that connects 2,000+ apps (Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, CRMs, AI tools) into automated workflows, with built-in Make AI Agents for smart, reactive scenarios. Upgraded directly on your own account — Core and Pro monthly plans available; annual plan on request.

Studocu Premium unlocks the full student document library — past exams, lecture notes and study summaries without blurred, paywalled sections. The upgrade is applied as an official Premium subscription on the email you provide, not a shared account. 1, 3 and 12 month options.

Canva EDU Pro-style upgrade unlocks premium templates, stock photos and videos, and Magic Studio tools (Background Remover, Magic Resize, Brand Kit) on the email you provide. A budget-friendly alternative to the official Canva Pro at ~$144/year. 1 month and 1 year options.

products.name_en: Google One AI Pro/Ultra & Antigravity Upgrade
products.description_en: Upgrade Google One to AI Pro or AI Ultra on your own Google account at Vietnam pricing: Gemini 3.1 Pro, Google Antigravity (Google's new agent-first IDE), up to 30TB of storage and YouTube Premium. Slot and Family options from 1 month to 1 year, at deep discounts off the regular price.

products.description_en: Abacus.AI is an end-to-end enterprise AI platform (AI as a Service) for deploying machine learning and deep learning models: forecasting, personalization, chatbots and workflow automation without a heavy engineering team. Basic and Pro monthly plans, activated on your own account.

Artistly is an AI image generation and design platform: turn prompts into high-quality visuals, remove or swap backgrounds, inpaint details, upscale images and create product mockups for marketing and e-commerce. Commercial and Premium plans.

Captions is an AI short-video studio: AI voice translation into 28+ languages with lip-sync, automatic editing styles, subtitles and effects — built for influencers and businesses producing social video at speed. Max and Scale monthly plans.

ClickSites is an AI website builder: describe your idea and it generates a complete site — layout, copy and images — which you can fine-tune with drag-and-drop editing, AI content tools and built-in image search. Basic and All-Access plans.

ClickUp is an all-in-one work management workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat and reporting. This upgrade activates Unlimited or Business seats on your own workspace — for teams that need more storage, guests and automation limits.

Comfy Cloud is the official cloud infrastructure for ComfyUI: run node-based image and video workflows on high-end GPUs without owning hardware — no more VRAM overflow or laggy renders breaking your creative flow. Standard and Creator monthly plans.

Consensus is an AI academic search engine for peer-reviewed papers: ask questions in natural language and get answers with citations and a Consensus Meter. The Pro plan gives unlimited Pro messages each month plus Deep Review quotas — a strong fit for students and researchers.

Elicit is an AI research assistant that analyzes millions of academic papers: smart literature search, automatic key-claim extraction and structured summaries for theses and papers. Plus and Pro monthly plans activated on your own email.

Enhancor.ai is a specialized AI tool that fixes 'plastic' AI-generated skin: it restores realistic skin texture, pores and lighting on AI images and digitalized photos, with a beginner-friendly interface. Basic and Creator monthly plans.

HeyGen is an AI video platform: paste a script, pick an avatar or Photo Avatar, and export talking-head videos with natural voice and gestures. The Creator plan includes 600 credits per cycle, videos up to 30 minutes, 1080p export, watermark removal and voice cloning.

Kits.ai is an AI music platform for musicians and producers: convert vocals with AI voices, train your own custom voice models, and generate royalty-free instruments and stems. Starter, Producer and Professional monthly plans.

MagicLight AI is a text-to-video animation platform: feed it a script or story and it auto-generates the storyboard, characters, dialogue and effects into a polished animated video — no animation skills required. Standard, Plus and Pro monthly plans.

Meshy AI is a generative 3D platform: turn text prompts or images into detailed 3D models with PBR textures in minutes, ready for games, animation and design pipelines. Text-to-3D and Image-to-3D, with Pro, Premium and Studio monthly plans.

OpenArt AI is an AI art and image creation workspace: generate images from prompts in seconds, choose from many models and styles, and refine with built-in editing tools — built for artists, marketers and creators. Essential, Advanced and Infinite monthly plans.

OpusClip turns long videos into viral-ready shorts for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts: AI picks the highlights, reframes to vertical, adds captions and scores each clip's virality potential. Starter and Pro monthly plans (promo and standard tiers).

Originality.ai is a content-integrity platform for publishers and agencies: industry-leading AI-content detection plus plagiarism checking with detailed per-paragraph reports and team management. Pro, Pay-as-you-go and Enterprise plans.

Pacdora is an online 3D packaging design tool: build dielines and 3D box mockups in the browser, render photorealistic previews and export print-ready files — no deep 3D skills needed. Lite and Pro monthly plans.

Scribd Premium unlocks the Scribd/Everand ecosystem — ebooks, audiobooks, documents and slide decks — via web or app according to your plan's quota. Two options matching the official tiers: Premium ($10/month value) and Premium ($85/year value).

TopMediai is an all-in-one AI content suite: natural text-to-speech with multilingual voices, AI music generation, voice cloning and AI video tools. SVIP plans for AI Music, Voiceover, or the full All-in-One bundle.

Tripo Studio is an AI 3D workspace: generate production-ready 3D models from images or prompts with textures, auto-segment parts for per-piece editing, and retopologize for clean exports. Professional and Max monthly plans.

UX Pilot (uxpilot.ai) turns prompts, sketches or PRDs into wireframes and hi-fi UI screens, with two-way Figma sync and HTML/CSS export — a fast wireframe-to-hi-fi loop for product designers. Standard and Pro monthly plans.

VideoCreator.io is a template-driven video maker: hundreds of ready-made templates for ads and social media, with logo, text, image and music swapping plus a royalty-free asset library — no editing experience required.

VideoExpress is an AI video creation platform: text-to-video, image-to-video animation, talking photos, and built-in sound and captions — everything in one browser editor. Foundation and All-Access plans.

vidIQ is a YouTube growth toolkit: topic research, keyword and trend analysis, AI video ideas, thumbnail generation and channel optimization alongside YouTube Studio. Boost (2,000 AI credits/mo) and Max (6,000 AI credits/mo) monthly plans, 1 channel each.

Vizard is an AI online video editor that turns long recordings into short clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts: automatic highlight extraction (AI Clipping), auto-subtitles and brand templates. Creator and Business monthly plans.

Vmake AI is an AI video and image creation suite: text-to-video, style customization, AI voices and marketing/tutorial video generation in minutes. Plus (monthly/annual) and Pro plans for creators and businesses.

WeShop AI is an e-commerce AI studio: AI product photography, model replacement, background generation and image enhancement tuned for online sellers — from small shops to large stores. Monthly plan plus prepaid point packs ($58 / $118 / $488).

Zapier connects 6,000+ web apps (Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, Facebook Ads...) into automated 'Zaps' without code: multi-step workflows, filters, paths and AI actions. Professional plan at the official $29/mo tier value — monthly or annual billing.

Base44 is an AI vibe-coding platform: describe your app in plain language and get a complete, working web app — no code, with auth, database and hosting included. Starter and Builder monthly plans, activated on your own email in 5–15 minutes.

Beeble AI is a cloud VFX platform for filmmakers: relight scenes, transform environments and composite cinematic shots while actors keep their natural motion — with full commercial rights from the official site. Creator and Professional monthly plans.

Coursera Plus and Coursera Business upgrades give unlimited access to the curated course catalog — Guided Projects, graded assignments and certificates — on your own email. Own-account Business and Plus options from 3 to 24 months, plus budget shared-account options.

Coursera Plus and Coursera Business upgrades give unlimited access to the curated course catalog — Guided Projects, graded assignments and certificates — on your own email. Own-account Business and Plus options from 3 to 24 months, plus budget shared-account options.

D5 Render PRO is a real-time 3D architectural rendering tool: ray-traced lighting simulation, one-click photorealistic perspectives and a smooth, intuitive workflow for architects and interior designers. Owner-account upgrade activated via email, 100% private.

Dzine AI (formerly Stylar AI) is an AI graphic design suite with professional-level control: precise layout edits, consistent characters, image-to-image styling and high-resolution exports for brand and ad creative. Creator and Master monthly plans.

Elicit is an AI research assistant that analyzes millions of academic papers: smart literature search, automatic key-claim extraction and structured summaries for theses and papers. Plus and Pro monthly plans activated on your own email in 5–15 minutes.

Envato Elements is an all-in-one digital subscription for creatives: unlimited downloads of premium templates, fonts, stock video, music, photos and graphics under a single commercial license. Core plan (1 month) activated on your own email in 5–15 minutes.

FangCode AI is a terminal coding agent: it reads your repository, edits files, runs tests and reports exact token, cache and cost usage for every run — with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints and a transparent per-run pricing model. Go plan, 1 month.

Figma upgrades on your own account: a Professional Full seat (official ~$16/mo tier) for teams needing unlimited files, shared component libraries and Dev Mode, or a 1-year Education plan for students and teachers.

Krea is a browser-based AI creative studio: image generation with style references, text/image-to-video, realtime canvas and upscaling — with models from Google, OpenAI, Runway, Kling and Krea's in-house model in one workspace. Basic, Pro and Max monthly plans.

Krisp AI is a real-time two-way noise-cancelling app for calls and meetings: it removes background voices, noise and echo from both mic and speaker in any conferencing app. Core (official $16/mo value) and Advanced (official $30/mo value) monthly plans.

Meshy AI is a generative 3D platform: turn text prompts or images into detailed 3D models with textures in minutes, keeping all your existing projects and data intact. Pro, Premium and Studio monthly plans activated on your own email.

Obsidian Sync keeps your markdown vault consistent across Windows, Mac, iOS and Android with near-instant sync and end-to-end encryption — no manual Google Drive/iCloud juggling. Owner-account upgrade on your own Obsidian account.

Pika is a generative video platform: create clips from text, images or existing video (Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video) with style presets, effects and lip-sync. Standard, Pro and Fancy monthly plans.

Rork AI builds and publishes mobile apps from chat: describe your idea and Rork designs and generates runnable SwiftUI (iOS), Kotlin/Compose (Android) or web code, with build/preview modes and on-device testing. Free tier is design-only; paid plans unlock builds.
Sloyd AI is an AI 3D model generator for game development: create game-ready objects from parametric templates and prompts, with fast iteration and OBJ/GLB/STL export. Plus and Pro monthly plans.

Storyblocks is a subscription stock media library: unlimited downloads of stock video, music, sound effects and images — no per-clip fees and no Content ID headaches. Essentials or Unlimited All Access, 1-month options.

Udemy Business opens the curated Business catalog — 30,000+ top-rated courses in tech, design, business and more, with certificates — as a Team Plan seat on your own email. 3, 6 and 12 month access options.
